content.text:
**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (preferred level).**

§ 8.2–8.3 already deliver our preferred renewal bargain:
- **12-month renewal terms** only ("successive twelve-month periods") — no multi-year auto-renewal.
- **30-day Customer opt-out**, with the deadline extended if Vendor fails to send its reminder.
- **Vendor reminder 60 days** before renewal.
- **Uplift capped at the lesser of CPI (preceding 12 months) and 3%**, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.

§ 7 contains no competing escalator. No redline proposed.
